Console-verified: the cave exit warp tile at (20, 26) (the image file's CAVE_EXIT); the twins at (15, 7) and (16, 7) seen from the image file's (14..15, 6).

BDSP differs from the decomp: column 23, rows 12..19 (the grass block's east column, open in both decomps) is a wall in BDSP: a walk north on column 23 from row 19 towards row 13 moved 0 tiles twice (Arduino-Source lab run r242a, 2026-10-31).
BDSP differs from the decomp: a tap north from (12, 6) was blocked twice (run r248a, 2026-10-31); the tile north of it, (12, 5), is tall grass in both decomps.

The ledge at (10..12, 15) is three wide (the image file had two). The Cut tree at (21, 6) blocks the way to the pocket (21..31, 4..5) and the east edge until cut; the item balls at (2, 10) and (20, 23) block their tiles until picked up.
